title: Sloth in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>
    <!-- branch -->
    <rect x='5' y='68' width='90' height='9' rx='4.5' fill='#8b5a2b'/>
    <rect x='5' y='68' width='90' height='4' rx='2' fill='#a9713a'/>
    <!-- body -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='24' ry='20' fill='#9a7b5c'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='57' rx='17' ry='14' fill='#c4a882'/>
    <!-- arms reaching up to branch -->
    <path d='M31 48 Q24 60 30 69 L38 69 Q33 60 39 50 Z' fill='#8a6a4a'/>
    <path d='M69 48 Q76 60 70 69 L62 69 Q67 60 61 50 Z' fill='#8a6a4a'/>
    <!-- claws on branch -->
    <rect x='26' y='64' width='4' height='9' rx='2' fill='#e0d0b8'/>
    <rect x='33' y='64' width='4' height='9' rx='2' fill='#e0d0b8'/>
    <rect x='63' y='64' width='4' height='9' rx='2' fill='#e0d0b8'/>
    <rect x='70' y='64' width='4' height='9' rx='2' fill='#e0d0b8'/>
    <!-- head -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='33' rx='19' ry='16' fill='#b08d68'/>
    <!-- face mask -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='36' rx='13' ry='12' fill='#e8d8c0'/>
    <!-- dark eye patches -->
    <ellipse cx='43' cy='31' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#6b5140'/>
    <ellipse cx='57' cy='31' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#6b5140'/>
    <!-- eyes -->
    <circle cx='43' cy='31' r='2.6' fill='#2a1f18'/>
    <circle cx='57' cy='31' r='2.6' fill='#2a1f18'/>
    <circle cx='43.8' cy='30.2' r='0.9' fill='#fffbe8'/>
    <circle cx='57.8' cy='30.2' r='0.9' fill='#fffbe8'/>
    <!-- nose -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='3.2' ry='2.4' fill='#4a3628'/>
    <!-- smile -->
    <path d='M45 42 Q50 46 55 42' stroke='#4a3628' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- scarf -->
    <path d='M34 47 Q50 54 66 47 L66 53 Q50 60 34 53 Z' fill='#e0453c'/>
    <path d='M64 52 L70 62 L63 63 L59 53 Z' fill='#c9332b'/>
    <path d='M34 47 Q50 53 66 47' stroke='#f2726a' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
    <rect x='44' y='49' width='3' height='9' rx='1.5' fill='#f7c94a'/>
    <rect x='52' y='49' width='3' height='9' rx='1.5' fill='#f7c94a'/>
  </g>
</svg>
